line.en: the city's public sauna on bergsunds strand, open daily 06:30 to 21:30. booked through the city; a cold friday evening fits.
line.de: die städtische sauna am bergsunds strand, täglich 6:30 bis 21:30 geöffnet. buchung über die stadt; ein kalter freitagabend passt.
line.tr: bergsunds strand'deki şehir saunası, her gün 06:30 - 21:30 arası açık. rezervasyon şehir üzerinden; soğuk bir cuma akşamına uygun.

sparks.why: Stockholm city's Hornstullsbastun page (parker.stockholm) gives daily hours 06:30-21:30 and booking through the city; a weekday pick, not a dated event.
